home.title: Welcome
home.intro: A full-stack application with an Angular frontend and an ASP.NET Core backend, built with:

stack.aspnet: ASP.NET Core and C# for cross-platform server-side code
stack.angular: Angular and TypeScript for client-side code
stack.pico: Pico CSS for layout and styling

tips.navigation: Click Counter then Back to return here.
tips.cli: In development mode, there's no need to run ng serve. It runs in the background automatically, so your client-side resources are dynamically built on demand and the page refreshes when you modify any file.
tips.builds: In production mode, development-time features are disabled, and your dotnet publish configuration automatically invokes ng build to produce minified, ahead-of-time compiled JavaScript files.

home.clientApp: The ClientApp subdirectory is a standard Angular CLI application. Open a command prompt there to run any ng command (e.g., ng test), or use npm to install extra packages.
